description_en: 🏡 1+1 Apartment for sale at Corner Residence 📍 📌 The apartment is in the final stage of construction, a very good investment or residential opportunity. 📐 Total area: 72.5 m² 🏢 Floor: 9 🌇 Unobstructed view of the center of Tirana 🛋️ Organization of the apartment: • Living room + kitchen 🍽️ • 1 bedroom 🛏️ • 1 toilet with window 🚿 • Very neat and functional floor plan 📐 ✨ The apartment offers natural lighting, open view and very practical organization, ideal for residence or investment. 💰 Bargain price: 182,000 € 💶 2500 €/m² (currently in the building the prices are around 2700 €/m²).
